tools.name: count_businesses
tools.description: Count verified US B2B businesses in the LeadQuasar database matching an industry, state and/or city, with how many have an email address and a phone number. Use this to answer questions like 'how many managed service providers are there in Texas' or 'how many dentists in Chicago have a business emai

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Return a sample of matching businesses with industry, location and data-quality signals. Contact details (name, company, email, phone, address) are never returned by this tool — it shows what exists and how reachable it is, not who to call.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries LeadQuasar covers and how many verified businesses each holds. Use this first when unsure what industry wording will match.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: count_businesses, search_businesses · Public sink: count_businesses, search_businesses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: count_businesses, search_businesses · Public sink: count_businesses, search_businesses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
